WITH bond_element_combinations AS (
  SELECT b.bond_id,
         MIN(a1.element) AS element1,
         MAX(a2.element) AS element2
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  GROUP BY b.bond_id
), combination_counts AS (
  SELECT element1, element2, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
  FROM bond_element_combinations
  GROUP BY element1, element2
)
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(bond_count) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM combination_counts;
